daily.question: PewDiePie’s first name is…
daily.explanation: PewDiePie’s full name is Felix Kjellberg.

daily.question: Markiplier’s first and last name are…
daily.explanation: Mark Fischbach is the creator who publishes as Markiplier.

daily.question: Jacksepticeye’s first name is commonly written…
daily.explanation: Jacksepticeye’s full name is Seán McLoughlin; Sean without the accent is also commonly written.

daily.question: Which gaming creator made “Top of the mornin’ to ya” part of his intro?

daily.question: The Diamond Minecart was an earlier channel name associated with…

daily.question: The Minecraft parody “Revenge” is associated with which creator?
daily.explanation: CaptainSparklez released “Revenge,” a Minecraft parody of Usher’s “DJ Got Us Fallin’ in Love.”

daily.question: “Tiny Box Tim” is a recurring character in which creator’s community?
daily.explanation: Tiny Box Tim is the small box character from Markiplier’s Amnesia community lore.

daily.question: PewDiePie’s early “brofist” sign-off usually involved…
options: A keyboard thrown in the air
daily.explanation: PewDiePie’s brofist sign-off mimicked a fist bump with the viewer through the camera.

daily.question: Which game studio made Amnesia: The Dark Descent?
daily.explanation: Frictional Games developed Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a recurring game in early horror Let’s Plays.

daily.question: The original Minecraft creator was known by which online name?
daily.explanation: Markus Persson, known online as Notch, created the original Minecraft.

tumblr.question: Tumblr’s queue is useful when you want to…

tumblr.question: One Direction placed where in the 2010 X Factor final?

tumblr.question: Which 1D member is from Mullingar, Ireland?
